packages.name: package:convohop/convohop.dart
packages.summary: Client SDK for Flutter apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events, conversation store, offline outbox, read receipts, typing, recent activity and call control.
packages.runtime: Flutter 3.38 or later (Dart 3.10 or later) on Android 7.0 (API level 24) or later and iOS 13 or later.

packages.name: package:convohop/calls.dart
packages.summary: Call media through the official `livekit_client` package.
packages.runtime: Flutter 3.38 or later on Android 7.0 (API level 24) or later and iOS 13 or later, with `livekit_client` 2.13.1 or later.

packages.name: package:convohop/push.dart
packages.summary: Push registration, notification payloads and the system incoming-call UI, through the package's own platform code.
packages.runtime: Flutter 3.38 or later on Android 7.0 (API level 24) or later with Firebase Cloud Messaging, and iOS 13 or later with APNs.

packages.name: package:convohop/io.dart
packages.summary: File-backed recovery storage for the conversation store and the outbox.
packages.runtime: Flutter 3.38 or later (Dart 3.10 or later) on Android 7.0 (API level 24) or later and iOS 13 or later.
